item.title: Karoline Leavitt Causes A New Russia Disaster For The White House
item.description: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt went into disaster damage control mode after she went on Fox News and downplayed Russia helping Iran in the war against the US

item.title: Fox News Digitally Removed Trump's Baseball Cap Disrespect Of Iran War Dead In New Propaganda Low
item.description: Fox News digitally substituted old footage to edit out Donald Trump wearing a baseball cap and not removing it during the dignified transfer of troops killed in the Iran war.

item.title: Top Democrat Turns The Tables And Takes Back Patriotism By Opposing Iran War Funding
item.description: Sen. Chris Murphy (D-CT) argued that anyone who truly supports the troops needs to vote against funding Trump's Iran war.

item.title: Democrats Have A Great Chance To Win The Texas US Senate Seat
item.description: Democratic candidate James Talarico leads both Republican candidates with much higher favorability ratings than Ken Paxton or John Cornyn, which means Democrats have a great shot in Texas.

item.title: Trump Holds Insane Press Conference As He Fails In Iran
item.description: Trump held a press conference to claim that the American people aren't impacted by rising gas prices, that his bombing of Iran helps China, and that his reason for going to war was all in his head.

item.title: After Classified Briefing, Senator Calls Iran War A Disaster And A Debacle
item.description: Senators were given another classified briefing on the Iran war, and they emerged warning that the war is a debacle and that Trump seems headed for putting US troops on the ground in Iran.

item.title: Even With Karoline Leavitt Babysitting, Trump Was A Disaster On Iran War Questions
item.description: As he was on his way to tout his failing economy, Trump was pressed by reporters about the Iran war, and even with Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt with him, it did not go well.

item.title: Iran War Breaks Trump As He Mentally Collapses In Kentucky
item.description: It was supposed to be a speech about the economy, but instead the pressure of failing in Iran apparently led Trump on a rant about Joe Biden and Barack Obama.

item.title: Trump Mental Collapse Worsens As He Claims High Gas Prices Are Good
item.description: Trump showed signs of the Iran war sending his mental state spiraling while speaking on Wednesday, but on Thursday, his new comments confirmed that his condition seems to be worsening.

item.title: Trump Shows It's 25th Amendment Time At Off The Rails Women's Month Event
item.description: Donald Trump complained that he is not getting credit for America's 250th anniversary, and that the economy is booming at a detached from reality White House event.
